messages.author: 149440eddb848db9
messages.subject: Re: error after installing R
parts:
Hi, Joshua

If your Revo.version does not exist, I can only think of two possible reasons:
  • You are not running RRO. If you are running RRO, then Revo.version should exist
  • Alternatively, you are running RRO in vanilla mode or have modified the Rprofile.site file
Do you get a startup message displaying the RRO message?

If you are in fact running RRO, you should get:

Revolution R Open 3.2.2
Default CRAN mirror snapshot taken on 2015-08-27
The enhanced R distribution from Revolution Analytics
Visit mran.revolutionanalytics.com/open for information
about additional features.

Multithreaded BLAS/LAPACK libraries detected. Using 2 cores for math algorithms.

Regards

Andrie
